import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation fields. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event}

{title_of_event}

Date: {scheduled_date}

{event_details}
{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a secure, sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines and formatting). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date for the event. extra_info : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS or HTML injection. safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Format the template with the sanitized values. return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=safe_title, event_details=safe_details, scheduled_date=safe_date, extra_info=safe_extra )
